usedFor: Streak holds pipeline boxes and contacts, and HubSpot receives them through “Create Deal” after “New Box”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Box” in Streak, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new box becomes a deal, so pipeline work appears in the CRM.

watchOut: “Box Change Pipeline” also reaches “Create Deal”, so a moved box can create a second deal.
